nodes.text: HMPV is a respiratory virus that primarily affects children, the elderly, and individuals with weakened immune systems. It's similar to the more well-known RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) and can cause symptoms ranging from mild cold-like signs to severe pneumonia. #VirusAlert
